title: Build Grave Accord with 63 bosses, clearer phases and distinct Hellish rules
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord runs 63 distinct boss identities across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons and six maps, with individual original boss themes. Fixed grades use -- / - / no sign / + / ++; Brutal adds B, secrets >10. This remains unfinished draft development.

Manual Early Watch feedback showed that entry phases were too brief and the phase shield event gave too much relief. Threats 1–2 now have two half-health phases retaining their final authored patterns. Health-bar dividers, phase number/total and an independent transition banner clarify the change. Normal health is unchanged. Brutal adds warned repeats of locked projectile volleys: two waves, or three from threat 5, under bounded queues and the unchanged 4,000-hostile cap. Controlled projectiles and the Warden retain their authored safe sequences.

Phase shield-break events now exist only on Baby/Easy Standard; every Brutal form and Normal+ remove them. All combat revival routes share one policy: Baby 100% health, Easy 50%, Normal 25%, Hard+ disabled. This includes solo, ally channels, Medic and supplies. Difficulty cards, final review, item descriptions and fifteen-locale help match the authority. The optional banked secret offer now follows a timeout-free Normal+ campaign without requiring the removed Accord event.

Hard retains half of static interior cover, rounded down. Insane/Hellish remove interior cover, with shared authority/prediction/presentation geometry. Hellish adds marked contact-damaging lava with a three-second opening tell and safe deployment regions. Every Hellish encounter is forcibly Brutal, including opening choices, contracts and the secret. Its global health is rebased to 1.2× before the forced 2× Brutal multiplier; the variant-aware analytical model includes the resulting 2.4× health and 1.5× deadline. Two original built-in ImageGen Gatehouse floor edits remove the appropriate painted fountains and preserve the original native.

The integrated Early Watch expansion adds Ashen Usher 1--, Brass Toad 1- and Ragpicker’s Kite 1, with distinct ticket-stand, locked-hop and wind/pin mechanics, 36 complete selected poses, three original scores and fifteen-locale help. There are 1,502 selected motion poses. Earlier master audio, exact requests/natives and loading references are preserved. The optional Expanded skill map presents all 54 existing skills per class with real prerequisites, bounded zoom, scrolling and keyboard navigation; classic stays the default.

Protocol 16 keeps online state strict and carries the known issued protocol-15 local Practice/profile revision forward without losing run identity, purchases, progress, receipts or preferences. Hellish contracts adopt the forced-Brutal rule. Existing older bounded migrations remain. Profiles/cosmetics, five modes, all seven current kits and bank-safe secret consent are already implemented.

Validation: 425 automated tests plus authored-content/fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass locally. New regressions cover actual revival health and rejection across all six difficulties, two-phase schedules, real echo emissions, queue limits, live lava damage, cover collision/prediction, every Hellish opening identity, actual difficulty-card markup, issued save/profile continuity and two-client Hellish replication/cleanup. Separate single-authority fixtures verify fifty clear deployment positions per map and 4,000-hostile cap enforcement. The two new floor natives pass independent hash/RGBA/opacity checks. Exact source/artifact hashes and failed attempts are retained under reviews/difficulty-pressure-2026-10-25/.

The roster remains 62 ordinary bosses plus one secret; 88 more ordinary identities, 59 original-boss quality passes and seven ability-changing class revamps remain. The optional skill map is implemented. Rendered animation, human balance/listening, native-language, physical-device, mixed-progression multiplayer/WAN/full endurance, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release acceptance remain open. Simultaneous boss pairs are a future encounter option, not included here.

The canonical Wiki has 18 pages and 29 images, published and hash-verified separately from source pushes. PR #14 stays draft, main protected, all older frozen previews preserved. The protocol-4 public Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows development release remain separate. No deployment, merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.

The latest follow-up gives Baby six shield-break circles with a two-second channel and Easy three circles with a three-second channel. Baby adds two actual cover props per map, rendered with existing prop art and shared collision/prediction geometry. Placement rejects narrowed boss engagement routes. New regressions verify solo/eight/sixteen/fifty-player timing, interruption resets, fifty deployment positions, all circle routes, live projectile blocking, issued protocol-16 migration and real two-client Baby/Easy cue cleanup. Protocol 17 and fifteen-locale menus include the revised values. All preview roots/processes through 5181 remain preserved.
